example.title: The Enterprise Building, Main Street
example.source: HABS WI-17 (photos/drawings via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS)

brief: Two-storey commercial building of 1848 built of fieldstone/cobble masonry with dressed stone quoins at the corners, three upper 6/6 windows, a plain boxed cornice and a small parapet; the shopfront has two big multi-pane windows either side of a recessed door and a signboard reading 'PALMYRA ENTERPRISE' - it housed the village newspaper. HABS drawings record plans and elevations.
